subject: general
question: International chess Olympiad 2022 is hosted by which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__Chennai__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This was the **44th **Chess Olympiad, also known as the **Indian Chess Olympiad.**
 
• It was organized by the **Fédération Internationale des Échecs (FIDE) in Chennai**, the state capital of** Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It was held in India from **28 July to 10 August 2022** at Poonjeri village in **Mamallapuram**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympiad was originally scheduled to take place in** Russia** but due to the ongoing **Russian-****Ukraine**** war**, the International Chess Federation (FIDE) started looking for new bidders.
 
• **India **emerged as the topper among other countries and won the opportunity to host the high-profile event for the first time.
 
• **The Union Government** provided the hosting rights of the world’s biggest chess event to** Tamil Nadu.**
